description: Creates a tag in a table. Refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the name matches, ignoring case, any tag, constant or block of the PLC. The result carries `overlaps`: the OTHER tags whose logical address overlaps this one (informational, never a refusal). Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/tags. M-off.
